title: Source Bangladesh crop, soil and rotation rules

acceptance.how: Identify Bangladesh-relevant BARC/BAMIS/BARI/BRRI/DAE/SRDI/FAO publications and rights.
acceptance.verification: Exact documents, region/version/rights and limitations are recorded.

acceptance.how: Choose one pilot and a small reviewed crop-season catalogue; preserve category/family and annual/perennial metadata. Target 6–10 supported records without inventing any.
acceptance.verification: Active records are source-gated; wider diversity/coverage remains a future expansion.

acceptance.text: Encode regional sowing and harvest windows
acceptance.how: Use cited windows/durations including cross-year seasons; do not guess dates.
acceptance.verification: Every active calendar/duration has region applicability and source evidence.

acceptance.how: Preserve unknown soil values and validate any pH/drainage/salinity/water thresholds.
acceptance.verification: Unsupported crop-region/soil conditions do not silently pass advice gates.

acceptance.how: Encode locally applicable host/family cautions and qualified soil-management traits with source/essentiality; no fertilizer, NPK depletion or numerical restoration model.
acceptance.verification: A family change does not automatically certify disease removal; repeated historical crops remain representable.

acceptance.how: Review rule parsing, seasons, unknowns and conflicting inputs with Fardin/Saim.
acceptance.verification: Reference cases prove unsupported/infeasible candidates are not rescued by preferences.

acceptance.text: Review, merge and hand off catalog
acceptance.how: Record validation status for each active crop-region rule and the contract revision.
acceptance.verification: G2 receives a reviewed catalog, exclusions and explicit evidence gaps.

acceptance.text: Obtain appropriate local review of active pilot rules
acceptance.how: Arrange documented review by an appropriately qualified local agronomic reviewer; resolve gaps or keep affected rules inactive. Do not equate student code review with certification.
acceptance.verification: Reviewer scope/evidence is genuine; unavailable review remains a visible release dependency.

history.note: Rebased planned work to the mandatory-now/future specifications. No product feature, review or delivery is marked complete.

next_action: Review G0 rules/schema now; source the minimum crop catalog after G0 is accepted.
handoff: Fardin consumes active rules in G2; Saim reviews climate alignment; unsupported cases remain explicit.
purpose: Make recommended crops and exclusions depend on documented local agronomy rather than plausible guesses.
